# Paper.js core 0.12.18

Pinned, unmodified browser build used for Boolean path geometry and validated SVG conversion. Local script loading keeps DRAW usable from file:// without a CDN or a build step. Keep this directory beside vector_pen_tool.html when copying the app.

Source: https://unpkg.com/paper@0.12.18/dist/paper-core.min.js
Upstream: https://github.com/paperjs/paper.js
API: https://paperjs.org/reference/pathitem/
